typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tocalypsotradeservdtccpartid_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsoleContactDtccPartId
fromcalypsoleContactDtccPartId derive({Dtcc_Part_Id$} = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
		{LONG_NAME$} = LONG_NAME,
		{LEGAL_ENTITY_ID$} = toString(LEGAL_ENTITY_ID),
		{SHORT_NAME$} = SHORT_NAME) ~> DataConversion2
DataConversion2 sink(input(
		legal_entity_id as string,
		short_name as string,
		attribute_value as string,
		long_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		legal_entity_id = {LEGAL_ENTITY_ID$},
		short_name = {SHORT_NAME$},
		attribute_value = {Dtcc_Part_Id$},
		long_name = {LONG_NAME$}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tocalypsotradeservdtccpartid_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tocalypsotradeservdtccpartid
